name: Santa Anita Mall
description: Westfield Santa Anita Mall is a premier regional shopping destination in Arcadia, California, offering an exceptional retail experience with contemporary fashion, dining, and entertainment options. Managed by Westfield, a global leader in shopping center development with locations across Europe and the United States, this center provides convenient amenities including Smart Parking and click-and-collect services. The mall serves as a dynamic community hub where visitors can shop iconic brands, enjoy diverse culinary offerings, and experience world-class events and entertainment.
demographics: Westfield Santa Anita Mall attracts an affluent, diverse demographic with a strong Asian-American presence reflecting the San Gabriel Valley's demographics, including families with above-average household incomes ($75,000-$125,000+) and professional couples aged 25-54. The trade area draws from upscale communities like Arcadia, San Marino, and Pasadena, with shoppers seeking a mix of contemporary fashion, dining, and entertainment options. Visitors demonstrate strong brand loyalty and preferences for both mainstream retailers and specialty stores, with high engagement in dining experiences and family-oriented entertainment activities.
summary: Westfield Santa Anita Mall is a premier enclosed regional shopping center in Arcadia offering upscale retail, dining, and entertainment with smart amenities and global brand excellence.
